correctness.rationale: Read actual frozen RESULT.md and independently reconstructed the first-arrival representation: an accepted trimer start is a first arrival covering at least one still-empty site, so K_s depends only on the 7 clocks U_(s-4),...,U_(s+2). This proves genuine six-dependence (independence of sigma-fields seven or more sites apart). An independent subset-order DP over all d+7 local clocks for d=1..6 reproduced exactly the six rational probabilities Pr(Y_0=Y_d=1) and their signs +,+,-,-,+,+; p=31/630 agrees with the one-site trimer law. Summation yields variance coefficient 8819999/136216080 and constant -52387/2702700 for n>=7. Positive variance and standard blocking for bounded six-dependent stationary sequences give the Gaussian CLT; seven residue subsequences yield the strong law. This proves only the terminal infinite-volume trimer process, not finite-time or other boundary laws; the DP does not independently prove an infinite CLT.
